issue.title: Warn when the HTTP method is not supposed to have a body

body: This is really a pathological case as a `GET` request is not meant to have a body.  The message is indeed not great, so I have opened #37219

Well, if we follow the norm, nothing prevents `GET` request to have a body : https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9112#name-message-body

But at least now developper will know where the error comes from.
